Customer case-study worksheet

Build an internal draft with evidence and publication permissions. No customer name, screenshot, testimonial or numeric result is approved by this tool. Nothing is published or saved automatically.

Review before publication

A shareable blank worksheet is also available. Worksheets stay in this page’s memory and clear on sign-out or reload. Download a draft to retain it in your approved storage. Publication requires a separate review and explicit instruction.
Google Ads conversion setup
Configure the account that manages conversions for each campaign landing page. Use the exact existing action names from Google Ads. These settings are staff-confirmed; this website does not connect to Google Ads, create actions, upload data or start advertising.
Account setup checklist
  1. Verify the 10-digit Customer ID of the conversion-owning account, including cross-account tracking if used.
  2. Create or verify two imported click conversion actions: Qualified Lead and Won Customer. Names below are proposed defaults until you confirm them.
  3. Choose one primary bidding goal. A suggested starting setup is Qualified Lead primary and Won Customer secondary; review this for your campaign.
  4. Use Count: One. Qualified Lead exports have zero value. Won Customer uses recorded agreed deal value, not a budget or proposal estimate.
  5. Enable auto-tagging and check that Google click IDs reach the matching US, UK or India CRM landing page.
  6. Confirm customer-data terms, the customer-permission wording and the account’s supported import method. Use the Google preview and error report before applying a file.
Google’s click-conversion file guidance · Enhanced conversions and Data Manager guidance
This release prepares GCLID click imports. Enhanced email/phone matching, GBRAID/WBRAID and automatic uploads are not enabled. Do not relabel an import as enhanced conversions. Account activation needs verification in Google Ads.
Review conversions for import
Campaign market selects the account originally used by the landing page. The customer’s editable business country remains separate. Only consented click IDs are retained, for up to 90 days. Raw identifiers are excluded from previews and enquiry records. Consent withdrawal removes the stored identifier and blocks future exports.
Downloading is not uploading. Repeated files use stable order IDs to support Google’s duplicate handling. Exports contain click identifiers and recorded conversions, without customer names, emails, phone numbers or requirements. Qualified requires a recorded stage event. Won also requires the current Won stage and an explicit deal value. Revoking consent here cannot retract a file already downloaded or uploaded; handle any external copy through your approved data process.
CRM workflow review requests
Assign an owner, record the next action and set a follow-up date using Open enquiry. Save the review status and outcome in the enquiry’s Workflow review panel. Reply drafts require staff review before copying.
Overdue means a past follow-up date or 48 hours without recorded first contact. Reviewed requests and closed sales enquiries stop appearing in active review alerts. Dates use India time.
Campaign cost comparisons
Record actual daily advertising costs to compare cost per qualified lead and won customer for US, UK and India campaigns. This ledger does not create or fund ads.
About cost coverage and sales attribution
Add a campaign cost profile
Use the exact campaign/source/medium tags from your landing-page links. Give each advertising account a unique campaign tag. Market is the customer’s saved business country; billing currency and account time zone are separate settings. A saved profile’s matching settings remain fixed to preserve its audit history.
Record or correct completed daily costs
Paste up to 90 completed account-day rows. Use decimal amounts without symbols or thousands separators. Only record zero when confirmed in the ad account. Missing days stay unknown. Existing dates are corrections with version checks and an audit trail.
Enquiry sources
Rolling period across all saved enquiries, independent of inbox filters. Source categories are inferred from browser referral/campaign information. Older enquiries without metadata appear as “Not recorded”. Counts are enquiries, not unique customers or visitor conversion rates.
Qualified means the team has confirmed a suitable need and agreed a next step. Proposal means a proposal has been sent. Won means the project has been accepted. Move stages only after these outcomes are confirmed.
